    ABOUT M. SHEPHERD

    M. Shepherd Commercial Roofing, based in Denver, Colorado, employs a team of 30 professionals. We specialize in large-scale industrial roofing projects and are recognized for our competitive pricing and excellence in project management. Our commitment to quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction sets us apart in the industry.

    OUR SERVICES

    Industrial Roof Installation

    From new installations to re-roofing projects, we specialize in industrial roof installation tailored to the unique requirements of large facilities. Our expertise ensures durable and high-performance roofing systems that withstand the rigors of industrial environments.

    Roof Maintenance and Repair

    We offer comprehensive maintenance and repair services for industrial roofs, addressing issues promptly to prevent disruptions to your operations. Our proactive approach extends the lifespan of your roofing system and minimizes unexpected downtime.

    Emergency Roofing Services

    Understanding the critical nature of roofing emergencies, we provide 24/7 emergency roofing services to mitigate damage and safeguard your property. Whether it's storm damage or unexpected leaks, our team is ready to respond swiftly and effectively.

    Roof Replacement and Upgrades

    For aging or outdated roofing systems, we provide efficient replacement and upgrade solutions to enhance the performance and durability of your industrial roof. Our expertise ensures minimal disruption and maximum return on investment.

    Consultation and Project Planning

    We offer consultation and project planning services to support the development of roofing solutions tailored to your facility's specific requirements. Our proactive approach and strategic planning result in successful, cost-effective roofing projects.

    Roofing System Evaluation

    Our team conducts thorough evaluations of existing roofing systems to identify potential issues and recommend proactive maintenance or improvement strategies. We ensure the long-term integrity and performance of your industrial roofing system.

    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

    What types of industrial roofing projects do you handle?

    At M. Shepherd Commercial Roofing, we specialize in a wide range of industrial roofing projects including manufacturing facilities, warehouses, distribution centers, and more. Our expertise covers new installations, maintenance, repairs, replacements, and upgrades for industrial roofing systems.

    Are your roofing professionals certified and experienced?

    Absolutely! Our roofing professionals at M. Shepherd Commercial Roofing are highly experienced and fully certified. They undergo rigorous training and have the expertise to handle diverse industrial roofing tasks with precision and skill, ensuring the highest quality workmanship and reliable service.

    Do you offer emergency roofing services for industrial facilities?

    Yes, we understand the critical importance of addressing roofing emergencies in industrial facilities. M. Shepherd Commercial Roofing provides 24/7 emergency roofing services to promptly respond to issues such as storm damage, leaks, and structural concerns, ensuring the protection of your valuable assets.
